content.short: JokeRace provides cutting-edge infrastructure for dao reputation tools, empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: Jokerace is a contest protocol for DAOs. Built organically for the Web3 ecosystem, JokeRace provides an essential suite of services focused heavily on dao reputation tools. By operating on Base and Ethereum and Polygon, it allows users to experience fast execution times while maintaining strong cryptographic security. The protocol is designed to be highly interoperable, aiming to become a cornerstone of the DAO Tools sector. Through continuous innovation, JokeRace contributes to the broader vision of a decentralized, permissionless digital economy.
content.meta: JokeRace is redefining dao reputation tools on Base and others. Dive into detailed analytics and explore JokeRace directly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
